index_coverage.appendix: complete: all 34 SI appendix items (A-1..A-34), tables and figures alike
index_coverage.chapters: NOT indexed. This book has no chapter list in this record at all, so a chapter or a chapter-numbered table such as 'Table 3-1' cannot be resolved here. Only its appendix is indexed.
index_coverage.english_units: NOT indexed. Appendix 2 repeats the SI tables in English units as A-1E..A-31E, printed pp. 947-987. Note A-15E does not exist: that appendix runs A-14E to A-16E.

book.appendix_title: Appendix 1 — Property Tables and Charts (SI Units)
book.note: Appendix 2 is the same material in English units, printed pp. 947-987, labelled A-1E..A-31E. A-15E does not exist: the English appendix goes A-14E to A-16E.

pointer_policy: Pointers only. This file names which chapter or which appendix table to open. It never carries a value from a table body, and none may be added. Checks that the lookup was well formed. It cannot tell whether the value you read is correct.
addressing: Ids are literal addresses, reached as appendix.<item-id> and chapters.<item-id>. A table and a figure sharing a number get different ids (appendix.table-a-9 vs appendix.figure-a-9) so a request for a table can never silently return a chart. The list is called `appendix` rather than `tables` because it also holds figures and, in some books, lettered appendices that are not tables at all. Table numbers are NOT portable between books.
